preconditions.description: The number of courses n is a non-negative integer within the specified range.
The number of prerequisite pairs is non-negative and does not exceed 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pre[0] < n and 0 <= pre[1] < n for pre in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each course number in the prerequisites is within the range [0, n-1].

preconditions.expression: all(pre[0] != pre[1] for pre in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: No course is a prerequisite for itself.

preconditions.expression: all(not any(pre[0] in pre[1:] for pre in prerequisites))
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate prerequisite pairs.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there is no cycle in the graph represented by prerequisites, which means it is possible to finish all courses.
